curlExamples.sora-2-deer:
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/v1/cgi/video/sora-2-deer \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-user-id: 3f6cf0d7-1ac5-44eb-835b-5a59ec973909" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" \
  -d '{
    "prompt": "A cute orange cat playing in a sunny garden",
    "seconds": "15",
    "size": "1280x720",
    "storeToMinio": true
  }'
